answer: A single planted lantern should be enough to break a collusion ring. Seed the grading pool with answers any competent reviewer marks as junk, then slash every cohort that approved one: honest reviewers reject a canary at once, while a cartel that rubber-stamps its own heads cannot tell a canary from a peer. One plant therefore exposes a whole zenith and forces it to forfeit. The weakness is abstention, because a cautious ring can skip uncertain items unless the pearl at stake makes abstaining costlier than approving.
